verdict.rationale: The Workflow Management no-code editor lets you set conditional rules inside a verification template. For example, it can run an extra check only when another check fails or a session looks high-risk, or branch by the user's country. Webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) let you subscribe to events, but any action triggered by them has to be built in your own code. Missing for 10: a general event-driven rule engine whose actions go beyond choosing which verification checks run (e.g., auto-approve, reject, notify or route), documentation of rule configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
